title: Understanding Ridge Regression
text: Ridge regression is a type of linear regression that includes a regularization term. This term is controlled by the hyper-parameter lambda (λ).

title: Effect of Lambda on Variance
text: As the regularization parameter lambda (λ) increases, the model becomes more constrained. This typically reduces the variance of the model.

title: Variance and Bias Trade-off
text: Increasing lambda (λ) reduces variance but can increase bias. The model becomes less sensitive to the training data.

title: Conclusion on Variance
text: Given the effect of lambda on variance, what can we conclude about the statement: 'As λ increases model variance tends to 0'?
